dedupe_keys.name: u s county level compound drought heatwave cdhw occurrence dataset 2000 2021

description: Amitesh Sabut and Ashok Mishra publish estimates of compound drought and heatwave occurrence for counties in the contiguous United States from 2000 to 2021. Zenodo lists annual NetCDF files and severity-group ZIPs under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The authors combine weekly US Drought Monitor classes with daily maximum temperature and define events as at least three consecutive days when drought and extreme heat coincide. County outcomes distinguish four drought-severity groups. This series can inform water-demand, electricity-load or emergency-service stress scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this county-level joint-hazard release. Its county drought threshold and local ninetieth-percentile heat threshold are analytical choices, not universal physical limits. Aggregation hides within-county differences and does not directly report infrastructure outages. No files were downloaded, and event frequencies or NetCDF variables were not recalculated.
